text: *Detective takes a deep breath and attempts to clear their mind.*

Detective:
Ok...This is how it had to have gone.
*Detective begins to write in their notebook as they speak what their writing aloud.

Detective:
The suspect killed the victim over the expensive knife set. The knife must be the weapon because of the blood on it.

Detective:
Yes. There's nothing else that it could be. I've thoroughly checked everything in this apartment.

Detective:
The suspect saw the bank statement and got upset. The victim tried to make space by using the apartment's furniture.

Detective:
Unfortunately, they weren't able to survive the encounter.

Doubt:
(There has to be more I haven't seen. There *always* is.)

Detective:
(No more doubting. I have to believe in my work.)

Cheif:
Then get in the cruiser! We gotta share everything with the rest of the force to figure out our next steps.
*The Detective and Cheif get in the cruiser and start heading back to the station.*

Cheif:
You were struggling a lot back there.

Detective:
Sorry...I got lost in my own head again.

Cheif:
You did what you had to do and got the job done. THat's what matters.

Cheif:
...Keep that notebook by your side. It grounds you pretty well.

Detective:
...Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.
